svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ESAF standalone, without a hub
svg.desc: The AI Factory has no hub. People reach the services over the internet from allowed IP addresses, with hybrid or public networking. The image also shows Microsoft 365 with Teams and Copilot, which reach a Foundry agent through Bot Service; Microsoft Power Platform with Copilot Studio and Power Automate, which reach the common virtual network; SharePoint and Microsoft Fabric as knowledge and data for Foundry IQ and the Fabric data agent tool; and API Management or Kong as the AI gateway. Numbered blue circles mark the code template for each part.

text.tspan: The AI Factory has no hub. People reach the services over the internet from allowed IP addresses, with hybrid or public networking.

svg.text: A numbered circle is a code template: select it, or find it in the table below the image. A dashed line is a private connection.
